rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides financial research capabilities through composable agent workflows built on the FlowLLM framework. Integrates web search (Dashscope, Tavily), Crawl4AI web scraping, and Tushare financial data APIs to enable deep research on stocks, funds, and other financial instruments. Features ReAct-style agents that iteratively gather evidence through tool calls, extract security codes from natural language queries, and compress multi-step research into structured reports. Includes specialized tools for Chinese A-share market data through TongHuaShun integration.
